headline.zh: 露营风户外度假咖啡馆

traits.zh: 室内有8-10个绿色户外风格座椅，室外设绿色折叠椅与小桌
traits.en: 8–10 green outdoor-style chairs indoors; green foldable chairs and small tables outdoors

traits.zh: 提供危地马拉瑰夏拿铁，带橙柚花香、微甜不酸
traits.en: Guatemala Geisha latte with orange-citrus blossom aroma, subtly sweet and low acidity

traits.zh: 整面临街玻璃幕墙，落地窗设计
traits.en: Full-height glass facade with floor-to-ceiling windows

traits.zh: 使用 Guatemala Santa Felisa 咖啡豆
traits.en: Serves Guatemala Santa Felisa coffee beans

linger.zh: 室内外多座位+露营风氛围促久坐
linger.en: Multiple indoor/outdoor seats + camping vibe encourages lingering

adventure.zh: 使用特定产地瑰夏豆并定制风味拿铁
adventure.en: Single-origin Geisha beans and signature flavored latte
